name: FactuPress – Duplicate Orders for PDF Invoices
author: Jairo Ochoa

sections.description:
FactuPress – Duplicate Orders for PDF Invoices adds a “Duplicate” action to the WooCommerce orders list, and to the order edit screen itself. It creates an exact copy of an order — same customer, addresses, products, fees, shipping and taxes — while leaving it completely free of any invoice trace: no FactuPress VeriFactu data, no invoice number or emission data from “PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce” (by WP Overnight), no Facturae signed-XML data. The new order looks exactly as if it had never been invoiced. There is no limit on how many times an order can be duplicated.

This plugin is an independent add-on and is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, WP Overnight.

Features

  • One-click order duplication from the orders list actions column.
  • A “Duplicate order” box on the order edit screen itself, with the same confirmation flow.
  • The duplicate never copies FactuPress VeriFactu, “PDF Invoices & Packing Slips for WooCommerce” or Facturae invoice data.
  • No limit on how many times an order can be duplicated.
  • Simple confirmation modal with progress and success/error states. After duplicating, jump straight to the new order; the page reloads automatically once the modal closes.
  • Compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Who is this for?

Stores that need to quickly recreate a past order as a new draft (for a repeat purchase, a manual order, or testing) without accidentally reusing or duplicating the original invoice’s fiscal data.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/factupress-duplicate-orders-for-pdf-invoices directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Orders — each order row now shows a “Duplicate” action in the actions column, and each order’s edit screen has a “Duplicate order” box in the sidebar.
sections.faq:
Can I duplicate the same order more than once?

Yes, there’s no limit. Each duplicate is created independently, without any invoice data, regardless of how many times the order has already been duplicated.

Does duplicating an order copy the invoice number or FactuPress VeriFactu data?

No, never. The new order is created exactly as if it had never been invoiced, regardless of whether the original order has an invoice or not.

What happens to stock when I duplicate an order?

Duplicating an order does not touch product stock.
